demos.title: About Demos
demos.body:
Each demo is designed to work with a **specific ontology and dataset**.

The ontology defines the structure — entities, relationships, and properties — and the data is generated to fit it. If you master the ontology, you can generate your own data and see it come to life here.

Use **Ontology Management** to explore or edit the schema, then **Document Ingestion** to load new data.

workflows.title: Welcome to TrustGraph
workflows.body:
Each card below represents a different **analysis workflow**.

Click any card to get started, or use the tabs above to switch between workflows and demos.

Need help? See the [documentation](https://docs.trustgraph.ai/).

graph-rag-query.title: Ask a question
graph-rag-query.body:
Type a natural language question about your data. TrustGraph will search the knowledge graph and generate an answer with sources.

**Tips:**
- Be specific — *"What companies supply lithium?"* works better than *"Tell me about lithium"*
- Follow-up questions work too

graph-rag-query.title: Understanding results
graph-rag-query.body:
Results show the AI-generated answer alongside the **graph evidence** that supports it.

Click any entity in the answer to navigate to it in the graph explorer.

solar-missions.title: Solar System Missions
solar-missions.body:
Explore space missions across the solar system.

Click on any **celestial body** to see the missions associated with it. The graph shows relationships between missions, agencies, and destinations.

Use the search box to find specific missions or space agencies.

graph-explorer.title: Graph Navigator
graph-explorer.body:
A schema-free graph browser — explore any knowledge graph without needing to know its structure.

- Click a **node** to expand its relationships
- Use the **search** to find entities by label
- **Right-click** for navigation options

This works with any RDF data, regardless of ontology.

hwsec.title: Hardware Security Explorer
hwsec.body:
Browse hardware components as a **decomposition tree** with security annotations.

Use the **search box** to find specific components. Each node shows its security properties and any known vulnerabilities.

Expand branches to drill down from systems to sub-components.

retail-assistant.title: Retail Shopping Assistant
retail-assistant.body:
An AI-powered shopping assistant that helps customers find the right products.

Try asking about:
- **PC builds** — *"I need a gaming PC under £1500"*
- **Gift ideas** — *"What would you recommend for a keen hiker?"*
- **Product comparisons** — *"Compare these two tents"*

The assistant uses the knowledge graph to find products and explain its reasoning.

brand-analytics.title: Brand Analytics
brand-analytics.body:
Analyse brand intelligence from customer interaction signals.

This dashboard shows what users **buy**, **reject**, and **why** — derived from shopping assistant conversations.

Use the filters to narrow by time period, product category, or sentiment. Click any data point to see the underlying interactions.

risk-management.title: Risk Management
risk-management.body:
Enterprise risk explorer with **time-windowed event analysis**.

The overview shows risk events, threat actors, and affected assets. Use the time controls to focus on specific periods.

- **Risk Overview** — summary statistics and trends
- **Event detail** — drill into individual incidents
- **Actor/Asset views** — pivot by threat actor or target asset

game-theory.title: Game Theory Visualiser
game-theory.body:
Interactive game tree explorer with strategic analysis tools.

- **Payoff matrices** — see outcomes for each strategy combination
- **Backward induction** — trace optimal play from the leaves up
- **Nash equilibria** — find stable strategy profiles
- **Sandbox** — modify payoffs and see how equilibria shift

Click any node in the game tree to focus on that subgame.

innovation.title: Innovation Intelligence
innovation.body:
Navigate the innovation ecosystem — organisations, capabilities, procurement routes, and people.

Use the toolbar to switch between views:
- **Organisations** — explore companies and their capabilities
- **Procurement** — find routes to market
- **People** — key contacts and expertise
- **GTM Advisor** — AI-assisted go-to-market guidance

law.title: Law in Context
law.body:
A multilingual legal explorer covering institutions, civic rights, compliance obligations, and legislative structure.

Browse by category:
- **Institutions** — government bodies and regulators
- **Rights** — civic and human rights frameworks
- **Compliance** — obligations and enforcement
- **Emergency powers** — exceptional authority provisions

All content is sourced from the knowledge graph and linked to its legal basis.

threat-overview.title: Threat Explorer
threat-overview.body:
Investigate cybersecurity risk events by pivoting through **actors**, **assets**, and **categories**.

Start with the risk event browser, then drill into any event to see raw **OCSF-formatted** evidence.

Use the search and category filters to narrow the event list. Click any entity to see its full context in the graph.
